steps.displayName: Stamp version and write build manifest

inputs.script:
set -euo pipefail
python -m pip install --upgrade pip
pip install -r services/settlement-gateway/requirements.txt

set -euo pipefail
cd services/settlement-gateway
python -m pytest tests --junitxml=$(Build.ArtifactStagingDirectory)/test-results/junit.xml

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

$staging = $env:BUILD_ARTIFACTSTAGINGDIRECTORY
$version = $env:SETTLEMENTVERSION
$package = Join-Path $staging "settlement-gateway-$version.zip"

# --- assemble the payload ----------------------------------------------
$payload = Join-Path $staging 'payload'
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $payload | Out-Null
Copy-Item -Recurse -Force `
  (Join-Path $env:BUILD_SOURCESDIRECTORY 'services/settlement-gateway/src') `
  (Join-Path $payload 'src')
Copy-Item -Force `
  (Join-Path $env:BUILD_SOURCESDIRECTORY 'services/settlement-gateway/requirements.txt') `
  (Join-Path $payload 'requirements.txt')
Copy-Item -Force (Join-Path $staging 'build-manifest.json') $payload

Compress-Archive -Path (Join-Path $payload '*') -DestinationPath $package -Force
Remove-Item -Recurse -Force $payload
Write-Host "packaged $package"

# --- register the package with the artifact registry --------------------
# The legacy pipeline pushed to Artifactory over a shared service account.
# The demo estate has no Artifactory, so registration is recorded locally and
# the publish step is skipped unless SETTLEMENT_REGISTRY_URL is configured.
$registry = $env:SETTLEMENT_REGISTRY_URL
$receipt = Join-Path $staging 'registry-receipt.json'
if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($registry)) {
  Write-Host "##vso[task.logissue type=warning]no registry configured; recording a local receipt only"
  $entry = [ordered]@{
    registry = 'none'
    status   = 'skipped'
    package  = [System.IO.Path]::GetFileName($package)
    version  = $version
  }
} else {
  $entry = [ordered]@{
    registry = $registry
    status   = 'published'
    package  = [System.IO.Path]::GetFileName($package)
    version  = $version
  }
}
$entry | ConvertTo-Json | Set-Content -Path $receipt -Encoding utf8
Write-Host "wrote $receipt"
